source: lab (real recording; background/person region blurred by a 'Segment Anything 2 Demo' edit, watermark bottom-right)
units: pixels (x right, y down, origin top-left) and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.motion: static: background patches shift < 0.4 px over the whole clip (scripts/camera_check.py)

perspective_cues.table_depth_vp_note: from the table-top left/right edges (y 460-525); rough, +/- ~15 px. Camera is slightly above the table top and looks almost horizontally (VP 22 px above the principal point -> camera pitched ~1.7 deg down if the table is level).
perspective_cues.ramp_slope_vp_note: from the ramp's left/right edges (left x 518@y367 -> 494@y477, right 659@y367 -> 675@y477). Angle between table-depth direction and ramp up-slope direction with f=763: ~25 deg (rough estimate of ramp inclination, sensitive to edge errors, +/- ~5 deg).
perspective_cues.ramp_width_ratio: ramp top edge appears 145 px wide, bottom edge 183 px -> ramp foot is ~1.26x closer to the camera than the ramp top if the board is rectangular

objects.name: book
objects.description: small hardcover book/notebook with a light blue-grey cover and white page block; a thin pale cord/bookmark string sticks out of its left end when it lies on the table
objects.occlusion: never occluded (the person's hands touch its two ends until ~frame 20)
objects.reference_point: centroid of the visible-book mask (cx, cy); bbox centre also given

at_rest_on_ramp_top_f0_20.note: cover face seen obliquely + ~5 px page edge

at_rest_on_table_f37_48.note: lying flat, seen almost edge-on: cover top 478-~500, page block ~500-512; manual zoom gives x 477-654

objects.apparent_size_vs_time: main-axis length grows 125-128 px (f0-22) -> 131 (f25) -> 141 (f28) -> 152 (f30) -> 163 (f32) -> ~172-174 (f36-48): it approaches the camera as it slides down the ramp

objects.name: ramp
objects.description: white rigid board (whiteboard/foam board) leaning back as an inclined plane on the table, its foot toward the camera; trapezoid in image

pixel_extent.measured_at: f48 (top, book gone) and f0 (bottom, book not yet there); corners rounded

objects.notes: The book starts with its upper part protruding ~10 px above the ramp top edge (book top y 345). A grey-white blob (x ~575-620, y ~340-356) above the ramp top after frame 21 is an artifact of the segmentation edit, not an object.

objects.name: table
objects.description: wooden-top table (brown wood grain) with dark front edge band; ramp and book on it; central pedestal leg below (x ~605-630)

pixel_extent.note: back edge partly hidden by the person's blurred arms; side edges blurred; values +/- 5 px (front) / +/- 10 px (back)

objects.name: person
objects.description: person behind the table, crouching (blue jeans visible under the table, x ~380-780, y 560-720); head behind the ramp top (dark blob ~x 560-640, y 320-350); bare forearms resting on the table either side of the ramp; whole person blurred by the edit
objects.motion: hands hold the two ends of the book at the ramp top (x ~500 and ~660, y ~360) until frame ~20, then let go and the arms spread/lower slightly (f21-23); otherwise nearly still. Not tracked (blurred, no clear reference point).

objects.name: tripod
objects.description: dark camera/light tripod behind the person, blurred; legs spread from x ~620-760 at y ~300-560; top with a light-blue light at (~690, 70)

objects.name: tv_monitor
objects.description: dark wall-mounted screen at top-right, x ~1010-1280, y 0-130, with a bright reflection near (1175, 50)

objects.name: walls_floor
objects.description: grey partition wall panels (vertical seams), bright ceiling light area top-centre, dark baseboard lines on the floor bottom-left and right

events.event: book held still at the ramp top by the person's hands
release / start of motion (first centroid change +1 px at f21, +5 px at f22)
slides down the ramp (accelerating; centroid y 369 -> 450)
front/lower edge reaches the ramp foot and the table (bbox bottom 481-483 = ramp bottom edge 482)
leaves ramp, pitches forward and lands flat on the table in front of the ramp foot
comes to rest on the table (centroid stable within ~1 px afterwards)
